literal_meaning: বড় জিনিসে টেপা দেওয়া (slapping or patting something big)
figurative_meaning_en: playing marbles or engaging in a trivial children's game
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে বড় কাজের বদলে বড়ে টেপা করে সময় কাটাচ্ছে।
example_sentences_in_english: Instead of doing important work, he's just playing marbles.
The kids are engaging in a trivial game like playing marbles on the street.
note: This idiom appears to reference a simple children's game, possibly regional or colloquial in Bengali-speaking areas.
